user_flow.primary_path:
**Step 1: Land on page** - User arrives via marketing link or direct URL - Hero headline + subheadline visible above fold - Primary CTA "Get Started" prominent without scrolling - Substrate texture + atmospheric overlay establish brand impression
**Step 2: Evaluate value proposition** - User reads hero subhead and evaluates features - Optional: scroll down to discover feature cards - Feature cards provide lightweight discovery of core benefits
**Step 3: Engage with CTA** - Click "Get Started" → navigate to `/register` with referral source - Click "Learn More" → navigate to `/about` or scroll to features - Both paths remove friction for different user intents
**Step 4: Next stage** - Registration flow (see `02_auth.xml`) - Or about/features page for additional context
user_flow.edge_cases:
**Asset timeout (>3s):** - Fallback to charcoal background (--sys-color-charcoalBackground-base) - Disable asset animations - Show error banner: "Asset load failed. Refresh to retry." - CTAs remain functional—page is not blocked
**No JS / SSR initial render:** - Hero panel renders with charcoal background (CSS-only fallback) - CTAs are standard `<a>` elements—navigable without JS - Feature cards show as plain text links
**Slow network (3G):** - Hero text loads immediately - Skeleton shimmer on assets until loaded - CTAs remain clickable

states.loading: - H1 replaced with Fraunces skeleton (pulsing --sys-color-worker-ash-40) - CTA buttons show spinner overlay, disabled state (opacity: 0.4) - Feature cards show grey skeleton blocks (200ms stagger) - Background asset loads with fade-in (300ms)
states.error: - If hero asset fails: fallback to --sys-color-charcoalBackground-base - If nav data fails: show cached nav links - MEGAPHONE error banner: "Asset load failed. Refresh to retry." - CTAs remain functional
states.disabled: - CTA buttons: opacity 0.4, cursor: not-allowed - color: --sys-color-concreteGrey

breakpoints.mobile: - Hero panel: full-width, stacked layout - CTA buttons: stack vertically, full-width (100%) - H1 font-size: 36px - Padding: 16px - Feature cards: single-column stack, full-width - CSS: .hero-content-panel { width: 100%; padding: 24px 16px; }
breakpoints.tablet: - Hero panel: max-width 600px, centered - CTA buttons: side-by-side, justify-start - H1 font-size: 48px - Padding: 24px - Feature cards: 2-column grid with full-width fallback - CSS: @media (min-width: 768px) { .hero-content-panel { max-width: 600px; padding: 32px 24px; } }
breakpoints.desktop: - Hero panel: max-width 720px, left-aligned in 2-col grid - Visual area: right column with asset - CTA buttons: side-by-side - H1 font-size: 56px - Padding: 48px - Feature cards: 3-column grid, full-width - CSS: @media (min-width: 1024px) { .hero-content-panel { max-width: 720px; padding: 48px; } }

accessibility_overview.focus_order:
1. Logo (skip-to-content link) 2. Nav links (Tab through alphabetically) 3. Primary CTA 4. Secondary CTA 5. Feature cards (Tab through, Enter to activate) 6. Footer links
Keyboard shortcuts: - Tab: moves focus forward - Shift+Tab: moves focus backward - Enter/Space: activates buttons - Esc: dismisses any open navigation menus
accessibility_overview.landmarks: role="banner" → TopNav role="main" → Hero + Feature sections aria-label="Primary navigation" → Nav links aria-label="Get started with CareerCopilot" → Primary CTA aria-label="Learn more about CareerCopilot" → Secondary CTA
